project_identity.text:
PROJECT NAME
  ESALL_CR1

  Funding of DTM generation by the ESA Lunar Lander project for the characterization of potential landing sites

lola_control_and_rms.text:
- ESA Lunar Lander products from DLR are tied to a set of LOLA elevations with RMS error of 0.5m
  (for CR1: ~450 LOLA orbit tracks), individual LOLA track correction (see Glaeser et al.,2013, 44th LPSC, #1967). 
  LOLA elevations are based upon radio and cross-over corrected LRO orbits.
  The RMS error of is the root-mean-square of the elevation difference between the LOLA points and the DTM.
  This value is a combination of error from the LOLA points and the DTM, and may give a measure of the 
  horizontal and vertical accuracy of the DTM.

processing_resolution_times_extent.text:
- The VICAR-based stereo-photogrammetric processing system at DLR was used to derive the DTM.
- Image resolution is 1 m/pixel. Post spacing in DTM is 2.0 m.
- DTM start time: 2010-09-22 12:24:35 and DTM stop time: 2010-10-11 12:33:46.
- DTM extents:
   Min. Lat.: -89.58125584
   Min. Lon.: 209.96127933
   Max. Lat.: -89.34838395
   Max. Lon.: 234.51582344

orthophoto_offsets.text:
SPECIAL PROCESSING NOTES
- Please note that the orthophotos, including the orthomosaic, have horizontal offsets relative to the DTM and to each other. These offsets vary over different areas of the images, and represent misalignments of up to 15m or greater. 
- The supplemental GeoTIFF products were generated from the NAC DTM by the LROC team at Arizona State University.

generic_artifact_caveat.text:
KNOWN ARTIFACTS
  These are known artifacts present in some, but not all, LROC NAC DTMs that are based upon DLR's processing.
  These artifacts may not be present in this DTM! Look at the terrain shaded relief and the confidence map
  to detect these before using the DTM!
  - NACL and NACR seams
	There are two NAC cameras (NACL & NACR) on board LRO. Stereo images are collected by acquiring images
	on two different orbits so the total parallax angle is greater than 12 degrees. The overlap between
	the four images (two pairs of NACL and NACR) provides three or four stereo models from which to collect
	elevation data. These stereo models are stitched together into one DTM. In some DTMs, the seams between
	the stereo models may be visible as long lines, usually up to 1 m difference. These seams are difficult
	to remove from the whole DTM.
  - Noise
	DTMs have varying level of noise from low signal images, low incidence angle, and jitter. The amount
	of noise may be detected using the slope map or the confidence map.

east_longitude_convention.text:
- zzzz = center longitude (the actual center longitude is multiplied by 10 to retain the geographic
		position to the nearest 10th of a degree, then rounded to the nearest integer). The longitude
		domain for all NAC DTMs is 360 positive east.
  Example: 	NAC_DTM_LINNECRATER_E280N0120.IMG is a NAC DTM of Linne Crater located at latitude=28.0N,
		longitude=12.0E in equirectangular projection.

confidence_codes.text:
CONFIDENCE MAP TABLE LOOKUP
  Value	 Description
    0	 NoDATA, outside boundary (e.g. out of stereo pair overlap)
    1	 Shadowed
    4	 Interpolated / Extrapolated (e.g. from neighbor pixels)
   14	 DTM information based upon successful correlations

interpretation.control_evidence: Product-associated LOLA control documented: about 450 orbit tracks for CR1, with individual track correction; not 450 independent ground check points.
interpretation.rms_definition: Elevation differences between LOLA points and DTM; combined contributions from both, per README lines 26-28.
interpretation.metric_scope: Reported ESA/DLR DTM-to-LOLA control-fit residual, not independent absolute registration or separate horizontal/vertical error bound.
interpretation.independence: Control and check-point sets are not distinguished; no independent validation residual list or control coordinates are supplied.
interpretation.frame: README does not explicitly name MOON_ME or DE421. PDS label lines 33-42 define projection/sphere/direction, not an absolute frame realization.
interpretation.version_binding: README dated 2012-10-04 (20-21); label v1.2 (12), created 2020-10-13 (28). No README version/hash binds the reported fit metric specifically to the supplied raster bytes.
interpretation.time_discrepancy: README times 12:24:35/12:33:46 (31) differ by seven hours from label 05:24:35/05:33:46 (24-25); reason/time convention not established, neither overwritten.
interpretation.horizontal: Up to 15 m or greater offsets in line 39 concern orthophotos relative to DTM/one another, not the DTM absolute horizontal error.
interpretation.artifacts: Lines 86-99 explicitly describe possible artifacts in some DLR DTMs; they do not establish presence in CR1.
interpretation.confidence: Categorical CONF codes documented (0/1/4/14); confidence raster not inspected here, no confidence score assigned.
interpretation.comparison_to_current_diagnostic: 0.5 m control-fit RMS and our 1.678667 m Site01 comparison use different samples, references and resolutions; do not treat as repeated measurement or infer product failure.

decision.reason: Retain 0.5 m only as named publisher-reported control-fit statistic, not a model error field.

readme_addendum.validation: Evidence-only update: source hashes, line excerpts, JSON consistency and unchanged scientific results checked; no scientific tests rerun.

limitations: User-uploaded hashes identify files, not independent publisher authenticity.
No independently verified absolute registration or quantified absolute error.
No statistical shift confidence interval; validation worsens for best training shift, so no correction applied.
Containing-cell 2/5/80 m resolutions differ on slopes. No blending or offsets.
Quality error is statistical Site01 RMS, not LROC accuracy or safety.
Grid slope is approximate projected finite difference.
Point-grid coverage is not continuous area or horizon proof.
Originals are immutable during an open session.
No horizon, visibility, optimizer, operation score or readiness promotion.
